audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Three.js renders the scene with PBR Materials (MeshStandardMaterial stone, SpotLight.map with PCF shadow map) and Postprocessing (EffectComposer: RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass). Canvas 2D is used only to paint the shared stained-glass CanvasTexture and the static stone grain. GSAP owns all motion.
Coloured light is a projected-texture approximation (SpotLight.map) with shadow-map occlusion from the frame and lead mullions; it is not physically accurate refraction, dispersion or caustics.
The projected image and the window emissive share one CanvasTexture; small registration offsets between texture leading and mullion shadows occur because the light axis is oblique to the wall.
Shadow-map softness/resolution (2048, PCF soft) is tuned approximately; edges may show slight aliasing.
The light shaft is a faint additive cone mesh, not volumetric scattering.
Bloom strength stays 0 in this 3 s preview; the white bloom finale and camera moves are reserved for the full video.
Typography uses the locally available Georgia/Times serif system font.
